_comment: Top panel. The eight org.kde.plasma.systemmonitor widgets that used to live here were replaced by ONE com.diegonmarcos.watchdog widget per cluster (my-konsole/configs/plasmoid). Each systemmonitor instance builds a sensor-face controller and a KQuickCharts scene graph inside plasmashell; fourteen of them settled at ~24% CPU and 410MB, of which 135MB was QML JS heap, to show eight numbers. The watchdog widgets read one JSON the my-konsole tray daemon publishes every 2s, so adding a metric costs a label rather than another sub-application. PSI is in there properly now too — /proc/pressure has no KSystemStats backend, which is why the old panel faked it with diskusage widgets pointed at pressure paths and titles that named something else.
